getting-started/forgot-password.alt: The Forgot Password screen with a single email field and a Send reset code button

getting-started/module-switcher.alt: The module switcher at the top of the sidebar, showing the current module, Skill Track, with an up-down chevron on the right

getting-started/reset-password.alt: The Reset Password screen: a six-digit code input, a new password field, and an Update Password button

getting-started/scope-switcher.alt: The scope switcher at the top of the sidebar, showing the current organisation, Erehwon CDEM, with a building icon and an up-down chevron on the right

getting-started/sign-in.alt: The AVUT sign-in screen: email and password fields with a "Forgot password?" link, and GitHub and Google social sign-in buttons below

getting-started/user-menu.alt: The user menu button in the sidebar footer, unopened: an avatar with the signed-in user's name and email and an up-down chevron on the right

getting-started/verify-email.alt: The email verification screen with six single-digit code inputs and a Verify button

marketing/skill-track-session.alt: Skill Track: recording a Rope Rescue Technician assessment session, assessing by person

notes/note-editing.alt: A note being edited: an editable title, Cancel and Save buttons at the top right, and a formatting toolbar along the bottom.

notes/notes-list.alt: The Notes page: a sortable list of notes with a New note button on the left, and the open note on the right with its pencil and menu buttons.

skill-track/create-session.alt: The New Session dialog, with optional Name, Date and Notes fields; the name shows the next session number as a placeholder.

skill-track/report-matrix.alt: The Personnel x Skill Matrix report: skills down the left, people across the top with rotated name headers, and a colored status icon in every cell

skill-track/report-matrix-cell.alt: The popover from clicking a matrix cell: the recorded result, when it was assessed and when it expires with relative dates, the assessor, and the note left with the check

skill-track/report-matrix-skill.alt: The popover from clicking a skill name in the matrix: the skill's name, its description, and how often it needs reassessing

skill-track/report-person.alt: The Personnel Competency report for one person: a summary line reading 50 current, 6 expired, 20 not competent, 8 not assessed, then a table of every subscribed skill with its status and last-checked date, grouped by package and skill group

skill-track/report-skill.alt: The Skill Coverage report for one skill: every person listed with their status and last-checked date, sorted with Not Competent and Expired above Current

skill-track/report-team.alt: The Team Competency report: one row per skill with a stacked coverage bar and the percentage of the team currently competent, grouped by package and skill group

skill-track/session-also-checked-by.alt: Recording rows where several say 'Also checked by Douglas Renshaw' with his result under the skill's name.

skill-track/session-by-person.alt: Assess by Person: the session's personnel listed on the left with one selected, and their skills on the right, each with Fail, Pass and More buttons.

skill-track/session-by-person-phone.alt: Assess by Person on a phone: a Person dropdown above the selected person's skills to record.

skill-track/session-by-skill.alt: Assess by Skill: the session's skills listed on the left with one selected, and every person in the session on the right, each with Fail, Pass and More buttons.

skill-track/session-by-skill-phone.alt: Assess by Skill on a phone: a Skill dropdown above everyone in the session to record.

skill-track/session-page.alt: A draft session's page: its details on the left, and a Contents card listing personnel, skills, assessors, skill checks and conflicts on the right.

skill-track/session-personnel.alt: The Change personnel dialog, listing the Erehwon Response Team with 18 of 32 personnel ticked, and Cancel and Save buttons.

skill-track/session-record-menu.alt: The Record menu open in the session header, offering By Person and By Skill, with the Contents card behind it.

skill-track/session-recording-options.alt: The Recording Options sheet: Recording Mode (By Person or By Skill), Skill Order (Alphabetical or By Package/Group), and Configure Session links for Personnel, Skills and Assessors.

skill-track/session-resolve-conflict.alt: The dialog for resolving a conflict: two assessors' checks of the same person and skill side by side, one picked, with an Exclude all option and Cancel and Save buttons.

skill-track/session-review.alt: A session's review page: Unique checks, Personnel, Skills and Coverage tiles, and a Conflicts card with six conflicts resolved and three still to resolve.

skill-track/session-skills.alt: The Change skills dialog, with skills ticked under the Search Techniques and Ladders skill groups, and Cancel and Save buttons.
